metadata.description: Pre-production PET 511 keV attenuation fixture transcribed and reduced from AAPM TG-108 broad-beam transmission data. Values require user verification and explicit approval before production use.

provenance.source_title: AAPM Task Group 108: PET and PET/CT Shielding Requirements
provenance.source_organisation: American Association of Physicists in Medicine
provenance.table_or_section: Table IV, broad-beam transmission factors at 511 keV; lead column
provenance.reference_id: AAPM Report No. 108; Medical Physics 33(1):4-15; DOI 10.1118/1.2135911
provenance.notes: Provisional piecewise-TVL reduction for contract testing: TVL1 is the approximately 0.1 transmission thickness; TVLe is estimated from subsequent attenuation decades. Verify against the source table and approved calculation method before production use.
